source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transgenic bacteria (PDF 163).

blocks.text: Bohat se jandaron ke genes plasmids mein dal kar bacteria mein dale ja sakte hain, aur transgenic bacteria phir bairooni genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain.

blocks.caption: Transgenic bacteria ke istemal (kitab ki misalein)
rows: insulin (diabetes), clotting factors (haemophilia), hepatitis B vaccine, Covid-19 vaccine, insani growth hormone (bauna pan), interferon (kuch cancers), erythropoietin (anaemia), tissue plasminogen activator (khoon ke lothre ghulata)
alpha-amylase (nishasta se saada sugar), chymosin (paneer ke liye doodh ka protein jamata), pectin-esterase (saaf phalon ka ras)
zehreele maadde torne wale enzymes jo aaloodgi ko kam zehreela banate
kachi dhaat se tamba nikalna, paare ki aaloodgi saaf karna, peene ke paani mein arsenic pakarna

blocks.prompt: Transgenic bacteria se bani do dawaen aur un se hone wala ilaaj batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do, maslan diabetes ke liye insulin aur haemophilia ke liye clotting factors, ya anaemia ke liye erythropoietin.

items: Transgenic bacteria dawaen, ghizai enzymes, zehr torne wale enzymes banate aur kaan kani aur aaloodgi mein madad dete hain.
